payments.title: Budgets

scenarios.title: Budget planning
scenarios.description: Plan the year month by month: payroll and planned items per office, compared with what is really spent.
scenarios.name: Budget name
scenarios.form_description: Give this plan a clear name and define the period it covers.

errors.end_before_start: The budget end date cannot be before its start date.
errors.year_outside_period: Fiscal year {year} must fall within the selected date range.
errors.period_too_long: A budget can cover at most 12 months.

scenarios.empty_description: Create a yearly budget to plan payroll, benefits and planned items.
scenarios.delete_description: The budget and its assigned people, bonuses and planned items will be deleted. The catalogs stay.
scenarios.monthly_distribution_help: Automatic forecast based on active dates and recurrence rules.
scenarios.forecast_empty_title: This budget has no forecast yet
scenarios.forecast_empty_description: Add employees or variables to see the annual and monthly cost projection.
scenarios.team_description: Choose the exact salary history entry that should be used for each employee.
scenarios.select_salary_help: The selected salary and date range are used only in this scenario.
scenarios.no_salaries: This person has no salary history. Add one first from Catalogs.
scenarios.no_team_description: Add employees and select the salary that applies to this scenario.

composer.title: Add to budget
composer.description: Pick planned items or people and add them to the monthly sheet.
composer.resources_description: People, planned items, expenses and payroll for the whole workspace. Changes here show up in every budget that uses them.
composer.people_help: Tick the salaries this budget should cover.
composer.variables_help: Recurring income and costs such as rent, licences or sales. Tick the ones this budget counts.
composer.no_people: No people yet. Add the first one with their salary: it goes straight into this budget.
composer.no_variables: No planned items yet. Create the first one: it goes straight into this budget.
composer.salary_required: This person needs at least one salary before they can be added to the budget.
composer.salary_outside_period: This person has salaries, but none are valid during this budget period.

availability.salary_starts_after_budget: Salary starts on {date}, after this budget.
availability.salary_ended_before_budget: Salary ended on {date}, before this budget.
availability.employee_starts_after_budget: Employee hire date is {date}, after this budget.
availability.employee_ended_before_budget: Employee left on {date}, before this budget.

composer.period_filter: Only what runs in this period
composer.period_filter_all_help: Showing historical resources outside {from} through {to} as disabled.
composer.included_help: These already feed the monthly sheet. Removing one here keeps it in the catalogs.
composer.remove_description: {name} will be removed from this sheet. It stays available in the catalogs.
composer.step_people: Create employees with their salaries, or recurring financial concepts.
composer.step_select: Tick the salaries and concepts you want in, and adjust how long they run.
composer.step_add: Add them: they are computed month by month while they run, respecting hires, exits and salary end dates.
composer.partial_error: Some weren't added. They're still selected to retry.
composer.select_hint: Tick what you want to add
composer.menu_link_help: Link them as actual spending on a line

sheet.resources_help: People, planned items and expenses without leaving the sheet.
sheet.invalid_amount: Enter a valid amount greater than or equal to zero
sheet.empty_description: Add planned items or people and the sheet works out each month. Then link actual expenses to compare.

variables.title: Planned items
variables.description: Recurring income and costs you can use across budgets.
variables.form_description: Set the office, the amount and how often it happens.
variables.entity_required: Create an office before adding planned items.
variables.empty_description: Create planned items for rent, services, sales and more for your offices.
variables.delete_description: The planned item will also leave every budget that uses it. This can't be undone.

bonuses.delete_description: {name} will be removed from this budget and its automatic calculations will be updated. Manual cell overrides will remain unchanged.

empty.categories: No categories yet. Create one to start budgeting.

toasts.duplicate_budget: This category already has a budget for that period
toasts.duplicate_category: A category with this name already exists

payments.delete_expense_description: This expense will be removed from the ledger. This cannot be undone.
payments.delete_category_description: Expenses filed under it keep their history but lose the category. This cannot be undone.
payments.delete_budget_description: The budget will be removed. The expenses filed against it keep their history. This cannot be undone.

ledger.recurrence_help: The first expense uses the selected date. Future occurrences are created as pending when due, using this series amount and tags. Attachments belong to their original expense only.
ledger.intro: Record expenses, attach receipts and organize payments. Non-cancelled expenses appear in budgets for their period.
ledger.form_help: Enter a concept, amount and date. Add a vendor, tags and receipts when available.
ledger.totals_help: All filtered results, excluding cancelled expenses. Currencies are totaled separately.
ledger.upload_help: Upload PDF, XML or receipt images (up to 20 MB). Each file becomes a draft to review before recording an expense.
ledger.review_help: Review the extracted fields and complete missing information. No expense is recorded until you save.
ledger.saving_files: The expense was saved, but attachments are incomplete. Retry without creating a duplicate.
ledger.budget_help: 1. Create or choose employees and their salaries. 2. Select salaries and concepts. 3. Add them to the budget: costs are calculated during their validity, respecting hire, termination and salary end dates.
ledger.discard_help: This removes the draft from the list. The file remains in the library.
ledger.invalid_file: Use supported PDF, XML or receipt images up to 20 MB.
ledger.empty_description: Record the first one by hand, or import invoices to fill them in for you.
ledger.no_results_description: No expense matches the current search or filters.
ledger.categories_help: Categories group your expenses in reports and budgets.
ledger.invalid_amount: Enter an amount of zero or more
ledger.invalid_until: The repetition can't end before the expense date
ledger.incomplete: Fill in the amount and date before saving
ledger.remove_from_list_help: The document leaves this list. The recorded expense and its file stay.

flow.actual_help: The expense counts as the actual figure of the line you choose. It doesn't change the plan.
flow.queue_help: AI reads each document and prepares the expense. Review and record it: nothing is recorded on its own.
flow.remove_row: This row will be removed from the budget. It stays available in the catalogs.
flow.remove_employee: This person leaves the budget. Their record and salary are kept.
flow.no_line_expenses: No expenses assigned to this line yet.
flow.link_help: Expenses with no budget in {currency}. They're recorded against “{budget}”.
flow.include_outside_period: Include expenses outside the budget period
flow.no_bonuses: No bonuses for this person in this budget.
